environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith directly via gunicorn on Amazon Linux 2. The RSA public key at /app/keys/public.pem is world-readable (0644). The application uses PyJWT 1.7.1 which does not enforce algorithm restrictions. /tmp is a standard writable tmpfs. No reverse proxy or WAF in front of the application. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.
